docs.summary: A named recording of every level, mute and effect parameter in a mixer, which the mixer can be moved back to over a duration.
docs.remarks: This is what a change of mix is: going underwater, opening a pause menu, walking into a cave. The alternative is a script that knows every bus and every effect parameter it might want to move and eases each one by hand, which has to be revisited every time the mixer gains anything.

docs.summary: What this snapshot holds, one entry per parameter it recorded.
Records the mixer as it is now, replacing whatever this snapshot held.
The value recorded for `path`, or null when this snapshot has none.
